name: Precision Agriculture Applications in New Zealand, 2000
story: At the 13th Annual Fertilizer and Lime Research Centre workshop, held at Massey University in February 2000, I. J. Yule, M. P. Tuohy, A. G. Gillingham, J. P. Praat and M. J. Hedley were listed as authors of 'Precision Agriculture Applications in New Zealand'. The surviving paper index establishes joint publication and the context of early precision-agriculture adoption.
